moments.title: Scotland's Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Tomorrow, Monday August 3rd, is a Bank Holiday in Scotland, marking a long weekend for many north of the border.

angles.name: Monday Off Vibe
angles.copy: That Monday feeling is even better when it's a Bank Holiday! Big up to everyone in Scotland enjoying the extra day off tomorrow. What are your plans for the long weekend? #BankHoliday

angles.name: Scottish Plans
angles.copy: Morning, Scotland! Who's making the most of the August Bank Holiday tomorrow? Sunshine or showers, we're here with the perfect soundtrack for your extra day off.

angles.name: Trent Bridge Action
angles.copy: It's match day at Trent Bridge! Trent Rockets vs Sunrisers Leeds in The Hundred. Perfect Sunday afternoon sorted for cricket fans.

angles.name: Producer Power
angles.copy: A true icon of alternative rock. Happy Birthday to Butch Vig, 71 today! From Nirvana to Garbage, his impact is undeniable.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are UK No.1

angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Sam Fender and Olivia Dean for another week at the top of the Official Singles Chart! 'Rein Me In' is definitely a summer anthem.

angles.name: TV Glamour
angles.copy: Don't miss your chance to see the new Strictly Come Dancing hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe and Johannes Radebe in action! Ticket applications for the launch close August 4th.

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
